query: SELECT p.id AS profile_id, p.email AS profile_email, p.company_id AS profile_company_id, p.role AS profile_role, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, c.email AS company_email, c.created_at AS company_created_at FROM public.profiles p LEFT JOIN public.companies c ON c.id = p.company_id WHERE p.id = 'cfa31225-6481-4cc3-9af3-6f009a9259cb' OR p.email = 'ezraincome@gmail.com' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 10; SELECT id, name, email, created_at FROM public.companies ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;
